Method of Attack: Starting a reverse shell using encoded Python payloads calling attacker’s machine and spawning a terminal using Python pty module
Exploitation based on public proof-of-concept exploit code
Discoverer: Numan Türle at Gais Cyber Security
Impacted Systems: Control Web Panel (CWP), formerly CentOS Web Panel
Attack Vector: Exploitation of CVE-2022-44877 vulnerability in CWP
Indicators of Compromise: More than 400,000 CWP instances accessible over the internet (CloudSek Shodan search)
Around 38,000 CWP instances seen daily in Shadowserver Foundation scans
Attacks observed from IP addresses in the United States, Thailand, and the Netherlands
